title: TUMIX: Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling with Tool-Use Mixture
authors_zh: Yongchao Chen、Jiefeng Chen、Rui Meng、Ji Yin、Na Li、Chuchu Fan、Chi Wang、Tomas Pfister、Jinsung Yoon（机构以官方论文为准）
best_for_zh: 研究推理预算分配与测试时扩展的读者。
one_line: TUMIX: Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling with Tool-Use Mixture
没有一种工具使用策略适合每个问题，但代理常在测试时承诺单一路径的推理、编程或搜索。
why: It makes a test-time decision auditable.
inclusion_reason: It studies allocation or use of test-time computation for reasoning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
No single tool-use strategy is best for every question, yet agents often commit to one reasoning, coding, or search path at test time.

The paper asks how extra inference work can change a concrete decision rather than merely lengthen an output. A valid comparison must account for the candidates, execution, verification, or coordination needed to obtain the reported final answer.

没有一种工具使用策略适合每个问题，但代理常在测试时承诺单一路径的推理、编程或搜索。

本文研究额外推理工作如何改变具体决定，而不只是拉长输出。有效比较必须核算获得报告最终答案所需的候选、执行、验证或协调。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea runs diverse tool-using agents in parallel, lets them share and refine candidate answers, and stops refinement when confidence is sufficient.

This turns test-time scaling into a controllable allocation problem. More computation is useful only if it adds independent exploration, reliable selection, correction, or tool-grounded evidence under an explicit budget.

核心思想是并行运行多样的工具使用代理，让它们共享和修订候选答案，并在置信度充分时停止修订。

这把测试时扩展变成可控制的分配问题。只有当更多计算在明确预算下增加独立探索、可靠选择、修正或工具支撑证据时，它才有用。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method runs diverse tool-using agents in parallel, lets them share and refine candidate answers, and stops refinement when confidence is sufficient.

A reproducible record should keep the prompt, all generated trajectories, tool or verifier outputs, allocation and stopping decisions, final answer, and total compute. These details permit comparison with a baseline receiving the same end-to-end budget.

该方法并行运行多样的工具使用代理，让它们共享和修订候选答案，并在置信度充分时停止修订。

可复现记录应保留提示、所有生成轨迹、工具或验证器输出、分配和停止决定、最终答案以及总计算。这些细节允许与获得相同端到端预算的基线比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper reports up to 3.55% average accuracy improvement with near-equal cost, and preserves performance at 49% cost after confidence-based stopping.

The result demonstrates the stated mechanism in its task and implementation setup, not a universal scaling law. Deployment should separately measure model calls, tokens, tool latency, and the quality of the final evaluator.

官方论文报告在近似相等成本下至多 3.55% 的平均准确率提升，并在基于置信度停止后以 49% 成本保持性能。

该结果证明其任务和实现设置中的所述机制，而不是普遍标度律。部署应分别测量模型调用、token、工具时延和最终评估器质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is a specific control rule for how the system spends additional test-time resources.

It is distinct from simply increasing sample count because it changes the relationship among trajectories, restarting, agents, tools, execution, or selection. The resulting record is auditable at the decision level.

贡献在于系统如何花费额外测试时资源的具体控制规则。

它不同于只增加样本数，因为它改变轨迹、重新开始、代理、工具、执行或选择之间的关系。由此得到的记录可在决策层面审计。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach can grow costly as agents, branches, retries, or executable checks are added, and its controller may be miscalibrated on another domain. Tool availability, verifier errors, correlated candidates, and cancellation overhead can change the apparent gain. Reuse should disclose the full cost ledger, including unsuccessful paths and tail latency, rather than report only a final accuracy.
随着增加代理、分支、重试或可执行检查，方法可能成本很高，其控制器在另一领域中也可能校准失效。工具可用性、验证器错误、相关候选和取消开销会改变表面收益。复用应披露完整成本账本，包括失败路径和尾部时延，而不只报告最终准确率。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a system can spend extra compute selectively and its intermediate work is observable. Match the candidate pool and total budget against a simpler baseline, then log which branch, tool, restart, or comparison changed the final decision. It is especially useful for code or agent tasks with executable or otherwise checkable feedback.
当系统能够选择性地花费额外计算，且其中间工作可观察时，可以使用本文。应把候选池和总预算与更简单基线匹配，再记录哪条分支、工具、重新开始或比较改变了最终决定。它尤其适合具有可执行或其他可检查反馈的代码或代理任务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the result as an allocation claim, not as proof that more computation always helps. Inspect the trace for genuine new evidence, compare total cost with a matched baseline, and separate coverage gains from selection gains. The most informative failures are cases where the extra search or coordination consumes compute but reinforces the same wrong answer.
应把结果读作分配主张，而不是更多计算总会有帮助的证据。检查轨迹是否包含真正的新证据，与预算匹配基线比较总成本，并把覆盖收益与选择收益分开。最有信息量的失败是额外搜索或协调消耗计算却强化同一错误答案的情况。
